question: What will Grand Theft Auto VI's PS5 Metascore be on December 20, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: Rockstar flagship open-world titles (GTA IV 98, GTA V 97, RDR2 97, RDR 95) cluster at 95-98. Reviews embargoed to ~Nov 18 (NateTheHate/Insider Gaming); no scores exist as of Nov 4. Human market: Polymarket 'GTA VI Metacritic Score' ($61k vol, resolves Dec 31, source Metacritic, platform unspecified) prices 90+ 98.6%, 94+ 93%, 96+ 78%, 97+ 57%, 98+ 21% -> median ~97; close but not exact match (date/platform differ), used as strong evidence. Kalshi KXMC-GTA6 exists but page unreachable. Slightly fattened lower tail for late-review drift (scores typically slip ~0-1 pt over a month) and delay/crunch/leak risk.
calls.dossier:
- Release: GTA VI set for Nov 19, 2026 on PS5/Xbox Series X|S (Rockstar X post Nov 2025; Engadget; Variety). Delayed twice (fall 2025 -> May 26, 2026 -> Nov 19, 2026).
- As of early Nov 2026, Bloomberg (Schreier) reported game not yet gone gold; Rockstar's Phil Hooker said work continues to last moment; not framed as a delay signal (Notebookcheck).
- Review code reportedly distributed late Oct 2026 (NateTheHate); embargo reportedly Nov 18, ~6-7 AM EST, independently verified by Insider Gaming (Shane the Gamer, Oct 27, 2026). Some outlets possibly embargoed to Nov 19. Not officially confirmed.
- As of Oct 27, 2026 no reviews/Metascore published.
- Wave of leaks in 2026; Rockstar called it heartbreaking (gtaboom).
- Reference class Metascores: GTA IV 98, GTA V 97 (PS3/X360), RDR2 97, RDR 95, LA Noire 89, Max Payne 3 87. Over Rockstar's mainline GTA/RDR flagships since 2008: range 95-98; over all Rockstar titles since 2008: 87-98.
- Pre-release pundit predictions vary: Insider Gaming once predicted 83-87 (egw.news); another outlet predicted 96.
- Human markets exist: Polymarket 'GTA VI Metacritic Score' ladder (90+/92+/94+/96+/97+/98+, ~$61k vol, resolves Dec 31, 2026, source Metacritic, platform unspecified); Kalshi KXMC-GTA6 ladder (page not retrievable). Manifold small markets with stale/odd states.
- Metascores often drift ~0-1 point downward in the weeks after launch as late reviews arrive; launch-day score with ~100+ reviews typically stable.
- Status quo: no score yet; question annulled if no release before Dec 20.
- Resolution: resolves off Metacritic PS5 page Metascore (Xbox Series X fallback), checked Dec 20, 2026; not user score, not OpenCritic.
- Event window: score as displayed on Dec 20, 2026; as of Nov 4 reviews have not started (embargo ~Nov 18).
- Searched but not found: actual review scores, Kalshi current prices, any official embargo confirmation.
